summary: 14-year-old boy backpacking near Kings Lake off Rollins Pass Road developed severe abdominal pain; his grandfather hiked out to Nederland and contacted the Boulder County Sheriff’s Office for help. Rocky Mountain Rescue Group and Grand County Search and Rescue coordinated a joint rescue; responders provided medical care on scene and the boy was able to hike out, then was transported by Grand County Emergency Medical Services to a local hospital.
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Grand County Search and Rescue; Grand County EMS
notes: Year pinned to 2014: the Mountain-Ear roundup item “On Monday, September 1” fits 2014-09-01 (Monday) and the roundup’s Aug-17 Crater Lake broken-ankle item cross-matches Alpine mission 14-81 / id 1923 (2014-08-17). Corrects the run-363 “2016 roundup” guess. The roundup’s “Monday, September 25” marijuana-grow claim appears to be an author error (2014-09-25 was a Thursday); the SAR items are unaffected. Grandfather reported from Nederland (Boulder County); patient transport by Grand County EMS.
